conclusion: Six original skipped declaration Default failures and12 repeated-header duplicate-declaration differences are fixed. Selected successful callback traces match pinned Expat across handler presence, modes, standalone flags, encodings and chunk boundaries.
implementation: Each raw declaration segment is assigned once, at skipped-reference boundaries, to preceding semantic events or conditional Entity/Attlist prefix events. The compatibility dispatcher evaluates handler presence when those events arrive.

Duplicate entity declarations produce an opt-in event with external/unparsed metadata. FFI preserves complete raw text without EntityDecl handler, and the sparse name/literal/closing tokens used by Expat when that handler exists.
New queued prefix metadata is charged before allocation; raw fragments remain allocator-owned and pending event traversal advances monotonically.
